subject: Physics
title: Kinetic Theory
summary: Gas bahut saare chhote molecules hain jo random motion mein hain. Deewaron se unki takkar pressure banati hai: P = ⅓ρv²_rms.
Temperature molecules ki average kinetic energy ka maap hai: har molecule ki average translational KE = (3/2)kT, gas koi bhi ho.
Equipartition: har degree of freedom ko har molecule mein ½kT milta hai. Degrees of freedom gin kar monoatomic, diatomic, polyatomic gases ke Cv, Cp aur γ milte hain.
Mean free path — do takkaron ke beech ki average doori — λ = kT/(√2 π d² P) hai: gas garam ya patli ho to badhta hai.

formulas.name: Ideal gas equation
formulas.formula: PV = nRT = N k T;  R = 8.314 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹,  k = R/Nₐ = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J/K
formulas.when: P, V, T aur gas ki maatra jodne wala koi bhi sawal.
formulas.mistake: Kelvin lo, aur P, V ke SI units (1 L = 10⁻³ m³) — bhoolo mat.

formulas.name: Pressure of an ideal gas
formulas.formula: P = ⅓ (N m/V) v²_rms = ⅓ ρ v²_rms
formulas.when: Pressure ko molecular speed se jodna.

formulas.name: Kinetic energy and temperature
formulas.formula: average translational KE per molecule = (3/2) k T;   per mole = (3/2) R T
formulas.mistake: Ye sirf T par depend — same T par har gas ki average translational KE same, mass se alag nahi.

formulas.name: RMS speed
formulas.mistake: M kg/mol mein (O₂ ke liye 0.032), g/mol nahi.

formulas.name: Degrees of freedom
formulas.formula: monoatomic f = 3;  diatomic f = 5 (rigid) or 7 (with vibration);  non-linear polyatomic f = 6 (rigid)

formulas.name: Law of equipartition
formulas.formula: energy per degree of freedom = ½ k T per molecule;  U = (f/2) n R T

formulas.name: Specific heats from f
formulas.when: γ aur molar heat capacities nikaalna.

formulas.name: Mean free path
formulas.formula: λ = k T / (√2 π d² P) = 1/(√2 n π d²)
formulas.mistake: λ ∝ T/P — pressure double karo to λ aadha, ulta mat lo.

formulas.name: Avogadro's number
formulas.formula: Nₐ = 6.022 × 10²³ mol⁻¹;  molar volume at STP ≈ 22.4 L

formulas.name: Gas laws (special cases)
formulas.formula: Boyle: PV = const (T fixed);  Charles: V/T = const (P fixed);  Gay-Lussac: P/T = const (V fixed);  Dalton: P = P₁ + P₂ + …

topics.title: Assumptions of kinetic theory
topics.explain: Molecules point jaise, random motion, aapas mein aur deewaron se elastic takkar, takkar ke alawa koi force nahi, aur takkar ka time negligible. Real gases low pressure aur high temperature par isse follow karti hain.

topics.title: Molecular nature of matter
topics.explain: Matter atoms aur molecules se bana hai (Dalton's atomic theory). Avogadro's hypothesis: same temperature aur pressure par sabhi gases ke barabar volume mein barabar molecules.

topics.title: Meaning of temperature
topics.explain: Temperature molecules ki average translational KE ke proportional hai. Absolute zero par ye motion (classically) ruk jaata hai.

topics.title: Degrees of freedom in detail
topics.explain: Monoatomic gas (He, Ar): 3 translational. Diatomic (O₂, N₂): 2 rotational aur = 5; high temperature par vibration 2 aur = 7. Non-linear molecule (H₂O, CH₄): 3 translational + 3 rotational = 6.

topics.title: Specific heat of solids
topics.explain: Equipartition se solid ke har atom ke 6 quadratic terms (3 KE + 3 PE), molar heat capacity ≈ 3R (Dulong–Petit law), high temperature par sahi.

topics.title: Mean free path and diffusion
topics.explain: Molecules tez (~500 m/s) chalte hain par itni baar takraate hain ki khushboo kamre mein failne mein time lagta hai. Low pressure par λ badhta hai — vacuum technology ka base.

topics.title: Real vs ideal gas
topics.explain: Real gases deviate karti hain kyunki molecules ka size hota hai aur woh ek-doosre ko kheenchte hain — sabse zyada high pressure aur low temperature par.

ratta: Cv = fR/2, Cp = Cv + R, γ = 1 + 2/f.
